description: Control Xiaomi/Mijia smart-home devices from DeepSeek Harness, bridged through Home Assistant
readme:
# dsh-mihome

![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-mihome)
![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-mihome)
![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/loki888666/dsh-mihome)

![DeepSeek Harness × Mijia](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loki888666/dsh-mihome/main/assets/deepseek-x-mijia-cover.jpg)

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 装上"控制米家智能设备"的能力：列设备、开关、调亮度、开合窗帘、启停扫地机、锁门、调温等。通过 **Home Assistant** 桥接，走米家云端或局域网协议。

```
你说："把客厅灯打开"
  └─> dsh agent 调 home_device_list   找到 light.客厅_吸顶灯
  └─> dsh agent 调 home_device_set    动作 on
  └─> 本插件 POST /api/services/light/turn_on（HA REST API）
  └─> HA 经米家云（或局域网协议）下发指令
  └─> 灯亮，返回"已执行 light.turn_on"
```
